name: Stealing Thunder Bluff's Flame
label: Quest
description: Stealing Thunder Bluff's Flame: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This flame, stolen from the shaman of Thunder Bluff, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Loremaster might know more...

clips.title: Progress
paras: You're practically glowing, traveler. What do you have there?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Unless I miss my guess, this fire has been taken from the cliffs of Thunder Bluff! How it sings with the power of the spirits! You are quite the thief, friend. Take this as just payment for your skill. Now, if only we had the flames of all three cities...
